reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis correctly links stacking fault energy (SFE) to deformation mode, but it oversimplifies by assuming compositional adjustments will reduce SFE without considering that many Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni subsets have higher SFE than the equiatomic baseline, and it neglects other critical factors like short-range ordering and lattice friction.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes decisive falsification criteria, but measuring SFE quantitatively in these complex alloys is notoriously difficult and the in situ TEM experiment is extremely challenging to execute and interpret unambiguously.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a central unresolved question in the field with a testable mechanism, but its value is limited by the oversimplified focus on SFE alone, ignoring the well-known complexity of deformation in these alloys.
